This deletion mutation was originally believed to stretch 1.02 kb (Batten Disease Consortium, 1995). It was later shown to span 966 bp, and is also called 1kb deletion. In culture, fibroblasts from a homozygous patient express a major transcript of 521 bp and a minor transcript of 408 bp (Kitzmüller, Haines, Codlin, Cutler, & Mole, 2008). The major transcript contains exon 6 spliced to exon 9 and is thought to encode a protein containing the first 153 amino acids of CLN3 plus an additional 28 novel amino acids resulting from an out‐of‐frame RNA sequence at the novel splice site.
